ITEM 1 | Pale yellow to creamy-white bite-sized florets with bumpy, rounded surfaces and slightly darker yellowish edges. Soft and moist-looking, with no browning or char. Pieces are about 2-4 cm across, scattered in several clusters over most of the plate, with some small crumbs at the edges. | 130
ITEM 2 | Tiny pale green flecks and fragments mixed among the florets near the center of the plate, with little visible sheen. | 3
